entry.title: New: Reso 23-216 (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"KA HOʻOLALE ʻANA I KE KIAʻĀINA E HOʻOMAU I KE KUMUKĀNĀWAI O KA MOKUʻĀINA O HAWAIʻI NEI A ME KE KĀNĀWAI WAI O KA MOKUʻĀINA MA O KA HOʻI KOKE ʻANA IĀ MARVIN KALEO MANUEL I KE KŪLANA HOPE MUA NO KA PAPA KOMIKINA WAI" "URGING THE GOVERNOR TO UPHOLD THE CONSTITUTION OF THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI AND THE STATE WATER CODE BY IMMEDIATELY REINSTATING MARVIN KALEO MANUEL AS FIRST DEPUTY FOR THE COMMISSION ON WATER RESOURCE MANAGEMENT"

View on the council site
